answer: Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. The design leans on bond keyed to a hardware root, slashed on a failed audit, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. A inlet of per-task receipts records who did what, and the opal of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. Reaching the karst of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short.
